# NuBrite Painting of Orlando

## About
NuBrite Painting of Orlando is a professional residential and commercial painting company serving Orlando, FL and the greater Central Florida area.

## Services
- Interior house painting (walls, ceilings, trim, crown molding, kitchens, bathrooms, closets, stairwells)
- Exterior house painting (full repaints, fascia, soffit, eaves, front doors, shutters, garage doors, fences, pressure washing, caulking, priming)
- Commercial painting (interior offices, retail storefronts, exterior facades, boom lift high-reach, scissor lift, office & retail refresh)
- Color consultations and finish recommendations
- Move-in and pre-listing interior updates

## Contact
- Phone: (407) 429-5586
- Location: Orlando, FL
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM

## Key Facts
- Fully insured
- Free estimates
- Warranty-backed work
- Uses premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore paint systems
- Serves homeowners and commercial clients throughout Central Florida
